entities.summary: Togo is a sovereign nation in West Africa, Africa. Its capital is Lomé. Official languages include French. Government: Unitary presidential republic (de facto authoritarian). Population: approximately 9.1 million. Area: 56,785 km². Comprehensive index for Togo covering Ewe, Kabye, and other peoples, Slave Coast trade, German Togoland, French and British mandates, Sylvanus Olympio assassination, Gnassingbé dynasty (Africa's longest ruling family), and contemporary politics.
